title: Necessitate
summary: NECESSITATE, verb transitive To make necessary or indispensable; to render unavoidable; to compel. The marquis of Newcastle, being pressed on both sides, was necessitated to draw all his army into Yor

inlines.v: NECESSITATE, verb transitive To make necessary or indispensable; to render unavoidable; to compel. The marquis of Newcastle, being pressed on both sides, was necessitated to draw all his army into York. Sickness might necessitate his removal from court.
